# Cipherframe

> Motion design studio for funded or live crypto teams. Every announcement (partnerships, listings, mainnets, upgrades, raises) animated within 48 hours, at flat prices from $200. Paid in USDC, USDT or card. Never memecoins, never project tokens.

## Offers

- Announcement Clip: $200. 10–15s, 16:9 + 1:1 + 9:16, captions, 1 revision, 48 hours.
- Feature Video: $350. 30–45s with script, 3 formats, 2 revisions, 4 business days.
- Unlimited Desk: $1,490/month. Unlimited announcement clips, one request at a time, each delivered in 48 hours; 1 feature video a month; brand motion kit in month 1; priority in launch weeks. Monthly in advance, 3-month prepay $3,990, cancel with 30 days' notice. Founding Desks: the first 5 are $990/month for 3 months.
- Protocol Explainer: $790. 60–90s, script + storyboard, 8 business days.
- Launch Pack: $1,290. 45s trailer, 60s explainer, 4 announcement clips, logo animation, 12 business days.
